_doc: What a targeted FModel export must contain for the ConfigDB/client extractors to run. The full Client export is ~1 GB of ConfigDB alone (486 db files); the extractors touch SIX of them. Verify an export with `node tools/check-export.mjs <export-root>` BEFORE running any extractor — a missing or zero-byte file otherwise surfaces as a wrong number, not an error. Paths are relative to the export root (the directory containing Content/, e.g. G:/Software/fmodel/Output/Exports/Client). Generated-by-hand reference; keep in sync when an extractor grows a new input.

configdb.why: SQLite tables of (Id, BinData) FlatBuffers blobs. Each needs its JS accessor from the `accessors` group to be readable at all — configdb.py pairs db_<X>.db with Define/Config/<Accessor>.js and reads the field offsets out of the JavaScript, so the schema is never guessed. The last two are read only by reconcile_effects.py, which writes a QA report (docs/effect-reconciliation.md) rather than committed data -- skip them if you are not running it.

paths.note: propertyindex table: attribute id -> key + IsPercent
one row per S1..S6 node with its BuffIds

accessors.why: The client's own schema for the tables above (Content/Aki/JavaScript/Core/Define/Config). Small, but an extraction silently cannot start without them.

clientLogic.why: Client source read as TEXT, not as data. These change only when the game's own logic changes, so they can be skipped on a pure content patch.

characterAssets.why: PER-RESONATOR animation and skill tables. This is the only group that scales with the roster, and the only one a CONTENT patch really forces you to re-export -- and then only for the resonators that changed. extract_timings.py and scan_bullet_timings.py os.walk() whatever root they are given, so point them at a single character directory to do one resonator.
notes: DT_SkillInfo lives at <CharacterDir>/Data/DT_SkillInfo.uasset (+ .uexp). Both halves are required -- the readers strip and re-append the extension.

data/timing-data.json records each covered resonator's own source_table path, so the <BodyType>/<CharacterDir> for an EXISTING resonator can be read straight out of the repo. A brand-new resonator is not in there yet -- find their directory by name under Content/Aki/Character/Role/.
Rover is FEMALE only in this project: FemaleM/*Nvzhu, never MaleM/*Nanzhu. Both ship separate bullet-id blocks applying the SAME damage ids.

runOrder: node tools/preprocess.mjs                       # writes data/hit-map.json, needed by extract-forte and extract_buff_facts
node tools/extract-forte.mjs                    # NO export needed: reads data/bindata/* + data/hit-map.json
node tools/preprocess.mjs && npm run meta       # re-bake, then re-rank
notInExport: data/bindata/*.json and data/extracted-nanoka/** come from Arikatsu and nanoka respectively, NOT from FModel. tools/extract-forte.mjs and the whole preprocess pass need no client export at all.
